**bout the Company:**

B2U Storage Solutions, Inc. (B2U) is the leading provider of integrated repurposing services for EV batteries in large\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). B2U utilizes its patented EPS technology to deploy battery packs without incurring repurposing costs. B2U’s BESS are interconnected to the grid, selling energy and grid services into wholesale markets. B2U’s BESS have been operational since 2020\. B2U’s second grid connected energy storage system has been operational since November 2023\. A third facility is now being converted from PV to a hybrid BESS facility.

**Job Description and Responsibilities:**

B2U is seeking a Senior Manager of Operations to join the leadership team, reporting to the CEO, whose responsibilities will include:

* Leading and managing operations staff and contractors who design, build, and deploy B2U’s BESS
* Build out the operations team, in conjunction with company leadership
* Working with company leadership to define strategic goals
* Managing B2U’s project deployments
* Lead team negotiating contracts with suppliers, engineering firms, contractors, and other third parties
* Lead team which handles purchasing
* Developing, implementing, monitoring and reporting safety and quality control/assurance procedures

**Skills and Experience**:

* Strong leadership, management and communication skills
* Project management, cost control, schedule development, and risk management skills
* Highly motivated, process\-oriented self\-starter who thrives in an innovative and entrepreneurial environment
* Ability to manage multiple priorities within schedule constraints
* At least seven (7\) years of experience with EPC work in power systems development and engineering
* At least five (5\) years of relevant experience leading people and projects
* U.S. citizen or U.S. permanent resident
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field; MBA preferred
* \- Proven experience in operations management, prefer

title: Business Development Manager, Data Centers
description:
**Job Description:**
====================


At Pentair, you will work alongside passionate problem\-solvers who are committed to the future of our planet. We put our mission into practice, helping the world sustainably move, improve, and enjoy water, life's most essential resource. From our residential water filtration to industrial water management to pool products and more, our 9,000 global employees serve customers in more than 150 countries, working to help create a better world for people and the planet through smart, sustainable water solutions.


We have an opportunity for a Business Development Manager, Data Centers to join our Texas team. You will be responsible for driving growth of Pentair solutions in data center applications through channel\-based go\-to\-market strategies, technical solution selling, and new market development. This role blends deep engineering expertise with commercial acumen to influence specifying engineering firms, distributors, integrators, and strategic partners while identifying and developing new ventures and emerging applications where Pentair can differentiate. This position will have the opportunity to take a new approach to how we influence and sell in this emerging market.

**You will:**

* Develop and execute a channel\-focused sales strategy for data center and digital infrastructure applications.
* Serve as a technical sales consultant for distributors, engineers, and integrators.
* Identify and penetrate key markets and ventures for Pentair solutions.
* Provide pre\-sales engineering support including solution design and application guidance.
* Train and enable channel partners on Pentair’s technologies.
* Collaborate with Product Management, R\&D, Marketing, and Business Development.
* Maintain awareness of market trends and competitive offers.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related).
* 5\+ years of experience selling through channel distribution mode

title: Director, Solutions Data Centers
description:

title: Senior Product Manager - MV switchgear
description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector, Power Distribution \& Controls Assembly (PDCA) Division is seeking a Medium Voltage Switchgear (MV SWGR) Sr. Product Manager. The role is preferred to be based in Greenwood, South Carolina and relocation is available. Remote work may also be available to those candidates in the US willing to work Eastern standard time business hours. Travel up to 40% will be required.  



  

Reporting to the Product Line Manager, this position leads product line strategy and action programs to drive profitable growth, strengthen market position, and advance the medium voltage switchgear portfolio. The Product Manager will lead two Associate Product Managers. The Product Manager will translate customer and market needs into portfolio priorities, product roadmaps, new product development programs, commercial plans, and effective launches. The role interfaces broadly with sales, engineering, operations, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, marketing, channel partners, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and customers. Success requires both strong business leadership and a practical understanding of engineered medium voltage power distribution solutions.  

  

  



**What You’ll Do**  

* Develop and execute the MV SWGR product line strategy, growth plans, annual priorities, and portfolio actions to improve sales, profitability, and market position.
* Own the product roadmap and lifecycle strategy, using Voice of Customer, market analysis, competitive intelligence, technology trends, and business performance to set priorities.
* Lead new product development and product or service launches through Eaton’s ProLaunch process, including business case development, value proposition, launch planning, commercialization, and post\-launch performance review.
* Provide leadership for the MV SWGR global product portfolio of Metal\-Enclosed, Metal\-Clad, and Gas\-Insulated (Primary and Secondary RMU) Switchgear
